---
title: "Visium BANKSY Niche Visualization"
author: "Codex"
format:
    html:
        code-fold: true
        page-layout: full
        fig-width: 12
        fig-height: 8
        toc: true
        embed-resources: true
params:
    run_dir: null
    focus_lambda: 0.2
    atlas_ncol: 3
    point_size: 0.35
engine: knitr
knitr:
    opts_chunk:
        warning: false
        message: false
        fig.width: 12
        fig.height: 8
---

```{r}
if (is.null(params$run_dir)) {
    stop("params$run_dir is required")
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(data.table)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(knitr)
    library(cowplot)
})

helper_path = normalizePath(
    file.path(
        dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)),
        "..",
        "..",
        "helpers",
        "spatial_helper_visium.R"
    ),
    mustWork = TRUE
)
source(helper_path)

run_dir = normalizePath(params$run_dir)
focus_lambda = as.numeric(params$focus_lambda)

spe = readRDS(file.path(run_dir, "visium_banksy_output.rds"))
qc_summary = fread(file.path(run_dir, "visium_banksy_qc_summary.tsv"))
section_summary = fread(file.path(run_dir, "visium_banksy_section_summary.tsv"))
run_summary = fread(file.path(run_dir, "visium_banksy_run_summary.tsv"))

preferred_cluster_col = if (
    "marker_cluster_column" %in% colnames(run_summary) &&
    nrow(run_summary) > 0 &&
    !is.na(run_summary$marker_cluster_column[[1]]) &&
    nzchar(run_summary$marker_cluster_column[[1]]) &&
    grepl(
        paste0("lam", gsub("\\.", "\\\\.", format_lambda_label(focus_lambda))),
        run_summary$marker_cluster_column[[1]]
    )
) {
    run_summary$marker_cluster_column[[1]]
} else {
    NULL
}

focus_cluster = resolve_visium_cluster_column(
    spe,
    lambda = focus_lambda,
    preferred_col = preferred_cluster_col
)
focus_dimred = paste0("UMAP_Harmony_BANKSY_lam", format_lambda_label(focus_lambda))
if (!focus_dimred %in% reducedDimNames(spe)) {
    stop(sprintf("Reduced dimension %s not found", focus_dimred))
}

sample_order = visium_sample_order(spe)
sample_palette = build_visium_palette(sample_order)
niche_palette = build_visium_palette(colData(spe)[[focus_cluster]])

qc_long = melt(
    qc_summary,
    id.vars = c("source_file", "sample_id"),
    measure.vars = c(
        "n_spots_input",
        "n_spots_hard_filter",
        "n_spots_nonzero",
        "n_spots_qc_keep"
    ),
    variable.name = "stage",
    value.name = "n_spots"
)
qc_long[, sample_id := factor(as.character(sample_id), levels = sample_order)]

sample_summary = section_summary[
    ,
    .(
        n_sections_total = .N,
        n_sections_kept = sum(status == "kept"),
        n_sections_dropped = sum(status != "kept"),
        n_spots_kept = sum(ifelse(status == "kept", n_spots, 0L)),
        median_kept_section_spots = median(n_spots[status == "kept"]),
        max_kept_section_spots = max(n_spots[status == "kept"])
    ),
    by = sample_id
]
sample_summary[, sample_id := factor(as.character(sample_id), levels = sample_order)]
sample_summary = sample_summary[order(sample_id)]

composition = visium_cluster_composition_dt(
    spe,
    focus_cluster,
    sample_order = sample_order
)
composition_heatmap = copy(composition)
```

# Run Summary

```{r}
kable(run_summary)
```

```{r}
kable(sample_summary)
```

# Spot Retention

```{r}
ggplot(qc_long, aes(sample_id, n_spots, fill = stage)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
        title = "Spot retention by sample",
        x = "Sample",
        y = "Spots"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# Niche Embedding

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 16
cowplot::plot_grid(
    plot_visium_umap(
        spe,
        focus_dimred,
        "visium_sample_id",
        sprintf("UMAP: lambda %s, colored by sample", format_lambda_label(focus_lambda)),
        palette = sample_palette
    ),
    plot_visium_umap(
        spe,
        focus_dimred,
        focus_cluster,
        sprintf("UMAP: lambda %s, colored by niche cluster", format_lambda_label(focus_lambda)),
        palette = niche_palette
    ),
    ncol = 2
)
```

# Niche Composition By Sample

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 16
cowplot::plot_grid(
    ggplot(composition, aes(sample_id, fraction, fill = cluster)) +
        geom_col(position = "fill") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = niche_palette, drop = FALSE) +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(
            title = "Sample-level niche composition",
            x = "Sample",
            y = "Fraction"
        ) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)),
    ggplot(composition_heatmap, aes(cluster, sample_id, fill = fraction)) +
        geom_tile() +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2166ac") +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(
            title = "Niche fraction heatmap",
            x = "Niche cluster",
            y = "Sample",
            fill = "Fraction"
        ) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)),
    ncol = 2
)
```

# Spatial Atlas

```{r}
#| fig-height: 16
#| fig-width: 16
plot_visium_spatial_sample_grid(
    spe,
    focus_cluster,
    title = sprintf(
        "Visium niche atlas by sample: lambda %s",
        format_lambda_label(focus_lambda)
    ),
    sample_order = sample_order,
    point_size = as.numeric(params$point_size),
    ncol = as.integer(params$atlas_ncol),
    palette = niche_palette
)
```
